paper.title_en: Quasi-homogeneous geometrothermodynamics of Hayward anti-de Sitter black hole surrounded by a cloud of strings
paper.abstract_en: The thermodynamic characteristics of the string cloud-enclosed Hayward Anti-de Sitter black hole (BH) are discussed. The study is carried out for a quasi-homogeneous structure derived by the Hayward-AdS BH encircled by cloud of strings using a Legendre-invariant method called Geometrothermodynamics (GTD). This approach facilitates the investigation of phase transitions by identifying the singularities of the curvature scalars, which aids in determining the phase transition patterns based on thermodynamic factors. In addition, we explore how the Hayward parameter lp may be understood as a thermodynamic variable inside the quasi-homogeneous thermodynamic framework, focusing on how it could influence phase transitions, particularly those with heat capacity divergences.
